en.title: Winter crisis deepens in Gaza as ceasefire warnings and military operations continue
en.dek: Board of Peace warns ceasefire faces imminent collapse as Israeli operations and regional tensions persist
facts: Board of Peace delivered second report to UN Security Council accusing Israel and Hamas of failing ceasefire commitments,Al Jazeera and AP News
Israeli army reported killing 6 Palestinians and blowing up homes in Gaza,Anadolu Ajansı and The Times of Israel
IMEMC News reported five killed and one succumbing to wounds in Gaza on Tuesday,IMEMC News and Dawn
Bahrain intercepted Iranian aerial attacks while Kuwait countered hostile drone attacks,The Straits Times and France 24
EU proposed 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine to avert cash crisis through 2027,The Guardian and The Straits Times
NATO Secretary General Rutte warned Russia may intensify winter attacks on Ukraine,The Kyiv Post
body: The Board of Peace, the US-led body monitoring the 2025 ceasefire, delivered its second report to the UN Security Council accusing Israel and Hamas of failing to meet commitments in Gaza, according to Al Jazeera and AP News.
The board warned the ceasefire faces imminent collapse without immediate action, as reported by both Al Jazeera and AP News citing the board's bleak assessment.
Israeli military operations continued in Gaza, with Anadolu Ajansı and The Times of Israel reporting the army killed 6 Palestinians and blew up homes during an operation.
IMEMC News reported that five Palestinians were killed and one later succumbed to wounds in Gaza on Tuesday, while Dawn carried the same report.
Bahrain's air defences intercepted Iranian aerial attacks, with The Straits Times and France 24 reporting the kingdom's response to hostile drone and missile threats.

NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte warned that Russia could intensify attacks on Ukraine this winter, urging allies to maintain military support as essential to securing peace, according to The Kyiv Post.
The European Commission proposed a 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine for 2027, to be repaid through future Russian war reparations, according to The Guardian.
Portugal ruled out transferring F-16 fighter jets to Ukraine, citing its own air defense requirements, while offering pilot training and aid, according to reports from November 18.
en.context: The Board of Peace was established to monitor the ceasefire agreement following October 2025, and its reports have increasingly warned of collapse. Israeli military operations and Palestinian casualties have continued alongside diplomatic efforts. Regional actors including Bahrain and Kuwait have reported intercepting Iranian aerial attacks. The European Commission has proposed a major loan for Ukraine, and NATO has warned of intensified winter fighting.
